brief.t: START HERE: Call Aaron and Evelyn, with Sam looped in, to reconcile Silk Factor's actual location and authorized disposition before further fulfillment.

ACT NOW 1: Silk Factor: reconcile new batch records before fulfillment. New records for both lots assert release but leave mandatory production/QC signatures blank and conflict on release/QA and expiry dates. They do not supply microbial results, client acceptance or actual shipment identity for the 26 kg waiver. Send internally: Aaron, Evelyn and Ron, confirm both lots' locations and shipments, then reconcile the new batch records, microbial results, Luke's acceptance and signed disposition with Sam today before further fulfillment.

ACT NOW 2: Morning Glory: approve safe formula before next samples. Evelyn says the cooling ingredient already exceeds the supplier-recommended use level; James requests stronger cooling only within safe limits. His Version 3 attachment is not current controlled approval or a verified safe-use limit. No further increase, newer-lot switch or fragrance addition is approved by that request. Send internally: Ron, Aaron and Evelyn, reconcile the controlled formula and supplier safe-use documentation with Sam today, record the approved cooling and fragrance limits, and approve the next samples before any increase or lot change.

ACT NOW 3: Lice Sisters: secure approved water for remaining Nit Glue batches. Production requested 220 kg, roughly 60 gallons, to complete remaining batches; the written arithmetic gives 217 kg, so confirm rather than silently reduce. Historical CRM water and today's contracted Culligan installation do not prove suitable released supply for this requirement. Repel's preservative gate remains separate. Send internally: Michael, Evelyn and Aaron, confirm the 220 kg requirement, water specification and existing supply today, then give me the exact purchase request and needed-by time for authorization without duplicating an order.

next: Recommendation: Resolve Silk Factor's physical disposition first, then secure a documented safe Morning Glory formula and suitable water for Lice Sisters.

Scheduled: One calendar event within 72 hours, nearest tomorrow November 19 at 10 AM Eastern (tentative). CRM My Tasks: 25 active, 20 strictly dated overdue, 2 due today November 18, 2 future, 1 undated. Proposed Oiana 1 PM today in mail is not a verified accepted calendar event.
Noise: 36 messages suppressed from 71 new inbound.

Morning Glory's explicit above-recommended-use concern displaces Roon's post-visit follow-through from the top three, not from follow-through; yesterday's visit outcome, lot codes, QC readiness and later-week shipment remain unverified. Other carried gates, including Talova, remain unresolved unless specifically evidenced.

WhatsApp remains signed out; reconnect Aidan's phone. Older unread coverage partial. Existing texting pause unchanged. Outlook originals/Sent and nine new documents text/cell inspected; only signed Culligan page 1 visually inspected; Morning Glory video not inspected. Both team evidence reviews returned, not human operational clearance. No sends, spending, payments, draft or CRM edits by this review.
signal: Protect controlled product release, safe formulation and production continuity. No shipment or release promises without proof.
